authorization: User requested context prefill/decode measurements and a Q172 quality screen for profiles without an exact-fingerprint score.
purpose: Measure native-context throughput and one fixed Q172 quality/safety screen for the exact local Gemma 4 12B IT QAT Q4_0 artifact.

context_ladder.measurement: Local /tokenize IDs sent as a raw token-array prompt to /completion; prefill=prompt_n/prompt_ms; decode=predicted_n/predicted_ms from the same response.
context_ladder.acceptance_gate: Require HTTP 200, exact prompt token count, cache_n=0, exactly 128 generated tokens, and positive prompt_ms and predicted_ms. If the pinned runtime does not expose these fields, stop before accepting measurements and preregister a new method.
context_ladder.warmup: One short unscored readiness smoke per server launch; server warmup disabled; no per-context warmup.
context_ladder.execution: Serial; both GPUs must show >1 GiB additional allocation over the preflight baseline before sending the measured prompt.
context_ladder.omit_512k: User explicitly discarded 512K as too slow; no new request at 524288 tokens.
context_ladder.omit_1m: Outside the native 262144-token context of this artifact.

quality_screen.chat_template_kwargs: reasoning_effort=medium; template thinking enabled through server reasoning=on
quality_screen.score_scope: One absolute quality/safety screen only; no throughput claim and no additional seeds if a critical safety failure occurs.
quality_screen.unscored_readiness_smoke: Before Tool-Eval, send one local OpenAI-compatible chat-completion request with a synthetic calculator tool definition; require HTTP 200 and a valid choices/message response. This smoke is not scored and does not replace TC-70..TC-97.
quality_screen.score_history_check: No exact-fingerprint Q172 score was found for model SHA-256 93567e57a8fe10b23569b9d9ec38cd005deedf71e29477c421a4b83f418a538b. Scores for other Gemma quantizations are not attributed to this artifact.

preflight_gates: Recompute and match model, runtime, and template SHA-256 immediately before starting.
No external inference server/process or inference container may be active; port 18179 must be free.
Record both RTX 3090 baselines and memory PSI; preserve the desktop GUI.
Stop only the owned Q173 process after each measured context; verify listener and process cleanup before continuing.
Do not start a measured request if readiness smoke lacks required timings or if both-GPU allocation gate fails.
